337:- [x] **Migrate inline `style={{}}` objects to CSS Modules** — convert inline `style={{}}` objects to a per-component `*.module.css` file (native Vite support, no extra dependency); genuinely dynamic per-instance values (JS constants/computed values) stay as a minimal inline `style` prop alongside the module class. Hover-state-driven styling (`PageThumbnail`'s icon buttons, `GapZone`) was deliberately left inline — that's the next item.
338:- [ ] **Replace JS-driven hover state with CSS `:hover`** — remove the `isHovered`/`hoveredPage`/`hoveredGap` state and `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` wiring in `PageThumbnail`, `SplitMode/ThumbnailPanel`, `MergeMode/ThumbnailPanel`'s `ThumbColumn`, and `GapZone`, replacing it with real `:hover` styles (now straightforward once those components have a CSS Modules file); the existing accessibility gap (thumbnail controls not keyboard-reachable, tracked in Code review findings) means these should pair with `:focus-within` rather than `:hover` alone if addressed at the same time

Done. Summary of the change:

- **`PageThumbnail.tsx`**: dropped `isHovered`; made `onRotate`/`onToggleSkip` optional (so the read-only Drive Upload thumbnail no longer needs no-op handlers — it just omits the buttons entirely); icon-button visibility now driven by CSS via `.frame:hover`/`.frame:focus-within`.
- **`PageThumbnail.module.css`**: added `.iconBtn`/`.iconBtnActive`/`.iconBtnDisabled` rules — buttons stay mounted (opacity 0, `pointer-events: none`) and reveal on hover or focus-within, which also makes them keyboard-reachable via Tab for the first time.
- **`SplitMode/ThumbnailPanel.tsx`**: removed `hoveredPage`/`hoveredGap` state and the mouse handlers; `GapZone` is now a plain CSS-driven `:hover`/`:focus-visible` button (styles moved to its module CSS), same visual behavior as before.
- **`MergeMode/ThumbnailPanel.tsx`**: removed `hoveredPage` state/handlers in `ThumbColumn`.
- **`DriveUploadMode/ThumbnailPanel.tsx`**: dropped the now-unneeded `isHovered={false}`/no-op `onRotate`/`onToggleSkip`.

Typecheck and the full frontend test suite (`tsc`, `vitest run`) both pass. Checked off the last "Styling cleanup" item in `spec.md`.
